title: The Whispered Fines
story: Rain drummed on the library roof, and four patrons came in to pay overdue fines, each for a different book. Wren whispered every amount as she took it, so softly that not even Wren heard herself. She whispers one more puzzle, too: the 1876 keeper's logbook is checked out to an "S. Bell," and Silas Bell, the last keeper, has been gone for eighty years. First things first: who paid how much, and for which book?

texts: Of the patron who paid 50 cents and the patron who paid 75 cents, one is Marta and the other is Basil.
The patron with the biography fine paid just a quarter more than the patron with the atlas fine.
Of Marta and Ivan, one paid the atlas fine and the other paid the biography fine.
The patron with the poetry fine paid either 50 cents or 75 cents.
The patron who paid 25 cents paid either the atlas or the biography fine.

25 cents must go with the atlas fine: clue 2 rules out the biography fine; clue 4 rules out the poetry fine; clue 5 rules out the thriller fine.

The thriller fine must go with $1.00: clue 5 rules out 25 cents; the other choices are already taken.
